messages:
Maya Singh: hi team! just unboxed my Lenovo ThinkPad X13s (SQ3) and followed the autopilot instructions. Company Portal crashes during enrollment with error 0x8018002F. Disk encryption options are greyed out. Can someone help with a short one-time admin or workaround? I need to install dev tools today. :grimacing: /cc @Sasha Li

Sasha Li: welcome Maya :wave: Sorry about that. 0x8018002F usually indicates the Intune client couldn't finish provisioning after Autopilot. Quick checks: can you run `winver` and `dsregcmd /status` and paste the main bits? Also confirm if you see "Device access: Disabled" under Settings -> Device encryption.

Maya Singh: ok pasted below (ran in normal user shell):
```
Windows 11 Pro 23H2 (Build 26031.1000)

DSREGCMD /STATUS
+-------------------------------------------+
| Device State: AzureAdJoined: YES
| Tenant: redwood-inference.onmicrosoft.com
| DomainJoined: NO
+-------------------------------------------+
```
Device encryption shows "Managed by your organization" but BitLocker settings are greyed out. Company Portal window crashes at "Applying device policies" and exits.

it-bot: [automated] autopilot_enroll_attempt failed for device (serial REDACTED) - error 0x8018002F - timestamp 2025-05-04T09:22:10Z

Sasha Li: thanks. Two paths: (1) we can push a profile tweak + ARM-compatible Company Portal/MSIX via device management (can take 1-2 hrs for propagation), or (2) grant a 8-hour local admin so an infra engineer can remote in and manually install the compatibility package and enable BitLocker. Which do you prefer? For fastest setup pick (2).

Maya Singh: (2) please — need to get VS Code + docker installed. I can screenshare now and keep laptop plugged in.

eng-infra: I can create a temporary local admin for 8 hours and join the session. Maya, please confirm you'll be at your desk in ~10m and on a stable wifi or tethered ethernet. We'll run firmware update, install Company Portal MSIX (ARM build), run `Manage-bde -on C: -RecoveryPassword` to force BitLocker, and verify recovery key escrow to AAD.

Maya Singh: confirming in 10m. thanks! :thumbsup:

Sasha Li: notes for the remote session (summary so thread is actionable):
- Backup any local files (small chance of reprovisioning prompts)
- Engineer will: install Lenovo FW/UEFI updates, sideload Company Portal ARM package, re-run enrollment, confirm Intune MDM profile applied, trigger BitLocker enablement and check TPM ownership, then remove temp admin.
- If enrollment still fails, escalate to eng-infra with logs: `C:\Windows\Provisioning\Autopilot\AutopilotDeviceUserState.log` and Intune device diagnostics export.

Maya Singh: session complete — eng-infra walked me through install. Company Portal ARM MSIX fixed the crash. BitLocker enabled and recovery key is in AAD. Thanks @eng-infra and @Sasha Li! :tada:

eng-infra: temp admin removed and account rotated. Closing follow-up ticket and attaching enrollment log snippet to the ticket. If you notice any app install issues (docker/WSL), ping eng-infra and we'll reopen.

Sasha Li: great — welcome again Maya! tagging ops to note ARM autopilot shim rollout for the next device batch. :sparkles:
